headline: Cheap growth, but the market is skeptical
chart_note: 52-week range: $190.12 - $370.86. Currently $254.39, about 31% below its high after a rough year.
why_today: Q3 FY26 revenue hit $6.76B, up 13% YoY, with non-GAAP EPS of $6.13 up 15% YoY - beating estimates and raising full-year guidance. Yet shares fell 4.45% on the report, extending a year-long slide as the market questions whether AI tools threaten Adobe's core creative-software moat.
pro_1: PEG ratio of just 0.70 - cheap relative to its own growth rate, and one of the lowest among large-cap software names
pro_2: Guidance raised despite the stock selloff, showing the business itself is still executing
con_1: Analyst consensus has cooled to Neutral (12 Buy vs 5 Sell) - real disagreement about the AI-disruption risk
con_2: Stock keeps falling even on good numbers - the market isn't rewarding fundamentals right now
